theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lipschitz_graph_approxTangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (U W : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (R : IMRep U n) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (a : Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (L : NNReal), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → LipschitzWith L f → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R.carrier ∩ W)), ∀ v : Euclid n, x = a + ι v + ι' (f v) → DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x = LinearMap.range (ι.toLinearMap + ι'.toLinearMap ∘ₗ (fderiv ℝ f v).toLinearMap)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
